chat.body: Why does EditPokemonPage bind the id to updatePokemon instead of passing it to PokemonForm?

`updatePokemon.bind(null, pokemon.id)` returns a function that takes only `formData`, the shape `PokemonFormProps` asks of `action`. `PokemonForm` therefore submits to `createPokemon` and to the bound `updatePokemon` in the same way, and never needs to know which Pokemon it edits.
